scientific_limitations: The unit-group isomorphism construction holds over every field, whereas the converse classification by order and conjugacy classes holds only within connected unicyclic height-one posets over the same finite field of size greater than two. title: Conjugacy classes and cycle detection in unit groups of unicyclic incidence algebras
